qa_stack.profile: bring the stack up with `docker compose -f compose.yml up -d --build --force-recreate --wait` and drive it over http://localhost:18085; the Firebase Auth emulator comes up beside it on http://localhost:18086 and every token a scenario needs is signed in there. Sandboxed runs reach both through the forwarded ports declared in qa-stack.yml
fixtures: an empty desk (DELETE /api/claims, holding the adjuster's token)
one Submitted claim filed by a holder through POST /api/claims, whose issued version the decision quotes
qa_stack.capable_of_rendering: the claims API against the live ledger, and the auth emulator against the three identities compose seeds into it
qa_stack.notes: two criteria need more than a request each: the compare-and-swap needs two writes off one reading with no re-read between them, and the durability of a decision needs the process replaced — `docker` is opted into in agents.yml for exactly that
